name: Cesare Perdisa
bio: Third at Monaco on his 1955 debut, sharing Jean Behra's Maserati, and third again at Spa in 1956 sharing with Stirling Moss — eight Grands Prix and five points, all of it before he was twenty-five. His Maserati 300S retired from the 1955 Mille Miglia. When Eugenio Castellotti, his close friend, was killed testing at Modena in March 1957, Perdisa stopped racing and never went back.
